text:
#!name=VVebo时间线修复
#!desc=Surge 模块 · 来源 Surge
#!author=ClashModule

[MITM]
hostname = api.weibo.cn

[Script]
http-request ^https:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/2\/users\/show\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/VVebo/VVebo_repair.js
http-request ^https:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/2\/statuses\/user_timeline\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/VVebo/VVebo_repair.js
http-request ^https:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/2\/remind\/unread_count\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/VVebo/VVebo_repair.js
http-response ^https:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/2\/profile\/statuses\/tab\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/VVebo/VVebo_repair.js, requires-body=1
http-response ^https:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/2\/cardlist\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/VVebo/VVebo_repair.js, requires-body=1
